headline: 7 questions committee is likely to ask about Dhahran Continental Industries; 4 of them the proposal does not answer. Hardest: Why bring a deal that earns 10.3% against a 15.0% hurdle?

questions.question: Why bring a deal that earns 10.3% against a 15.0% hurdle?
questions.answer: Lifetime RAROC is 10.3% against a hurdle of 15.0% (SVA SAR -0.28m). The margin that brings it to the hurdle is 282 bps against 190 bps asked.
questions.avoided_reason: The proposal names no pricing or structure fix for the shortfall.
questions.asks_for: Reverse solver: the smallest change that clears

questions.question: It breaks at mild stress: what protects the bank when it does?
questions.answer: It breaks first at mild severity (1 scenario: Revenue −10%) on covenants, leverage, limits. Verdict under the R12 rule: Restructure, tier High.
questions.avoided_reason: No covenant, trigger or monitoring plan covers the metric that breaks.

questions.question: Connected party classified: what is the answer?
questions.answer: 1 connected party classified as at 2026Q2: Taif Central Trading (guarantee; stage 3, in default, unlikely to pay; exposure with the bank SAR 34.6m). Open high finding, raised in the review.

questions.question: Threat: Manufacturing is exposed to feedstock and energy prices, export routes and demand from the oil and gas supply chain; the Stress Lab macro family runs these shocks on this deal. What mitigates it?
questions.answer: No covering mitigant is recorded. Suggested in the SWOT: Run the Stress Lab macro family on this deal; a driver that breaks at moderate severity becomes a named monitoring trigger.
questions.avoided_reason: The SWOT marks it as not covered.

questions.question: On a similar deal (R12-TWA, Al Sahel Building Materials Trading LLC) the committee required "Route business of at least 2x total limits (SAR 360.0m) per year through the bank". Why not here?
questions.answer: Credit Committee set it (CC-2025-118, routing) on R12-TWA (Wholesale Trade, BB, similarity 0.39). This proposal carries no routing condition of that kind.
questions.avoided_reason: The proposal carries no equivalent condition.

questions.question: Can the client carry this debt, and how much covenant headroom is left?
questions.answer: After the deal DSCR is 2.01x (covenant 1.20x) and Debt/EBITDA 3.53x (covenant 4.00x), on the latest actual year of the proposal financials.

method:
(deterministic writer, N3)
  Candidate questions come from eight sources, each scored for how hard a committee would press it:
    returns      engine.analyse: lifetime RAROC against the hurdle, breakeven margin (engine.breakeven_margin);
                 when it clears, the downgrade notches before it stops clearing (optimizer.robustness)
    limits       every hard or policy breach after the deal (constraints), with the approval level (DoA)
    stress       the latest dd_stress_result run: the mildest severity that still breaks something, what breaks,
                 the verdict and tier (stress2.verdict rule), and the named triggers of dd_monitoring_plan
    findings     open critical and high dd_review_finding rows, with their evidence relation
    weaknesses   dd_swot weaknesses and threats with no covering mitigant (covered_flag 0)
    group        dd_group_exposure (group total) and the connected-group limit after the deal
    conditions   dd_condition rows set by an earlier committee (prior_committee_ref) that were not complied or
                 breached, and the earlier committee decision (dd_reference)
    precedent    conditions earlier committees set on similar deals
